findings.why: Topic and lock are written by two separate non-atomic fs::write calls, so a kill between them leaves a pointer with no lock entry.
Matches example id in prose failing verify.
Matches flags not recorded in seal.
model_at refuses --repo, so --since and --diff fail on multi-repo; real but a deliberate, explicit error message.
Pairwise merge is commutative but not associative, so three or more twins depend on insertion order; that order is deterministic source order, so platform-dependence is overstated.
Matches closure shadowing keeps outer type.
Matches untyped closure parameter by-name guessing.
A single over-budget topic returns TopicOverBudget and exits 1 as claimed, but it names the topic and is a documented invariant.
A second reachable candidate removes the inferred edge as claimed, but the doc states this is deliberate ambiguity handling.
No expands link below min_calls is real, but the default is 1 and expands None is accurate; the agent-misreading consequence is speculative.
Orphan detection requires an .md extension, so a _model.json left from an earlier run is never deleted after --no-model.
